meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 它把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 的记忆文件搬进统一的 memory/ 目录和 instructions.prepend.md:先原样暂存,符号链接只移链接不动目标,再整理成带索引的概念文件,并给出迁移对照报告,等你确认才算完成。
howto.when: 更新提示出现共享记忆破坏性变更后,或某个 group 还留有 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md、CLAUDE.local.md 等旧记忆文件时;你说「migrate memory」「legacy memory」等也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 group 的旧记忆迁移到共享 memory 树
say.note: 它会先列出受影响的 group,等你批准后再移动文件。

say.text: 看看哪些 group 还留着旧记忆文件要迁移
切换后 agent 什么都不记得了,帮我迁移记忆
say.note: 对受影响的 group 走一遍迁移流程。

howto.what_en: It moves legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory into the shared memory/ tree and instructions.prepend.md: stages files as-is, quarantines symlinks without following them, then organizes facts with indexes and a report you approve.
howto.when_en: Runs after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md, etc. Also triggers on "migrate memory" or "legacy memory".

say_en.text: Migrate this group's legacy memory into the shared memory tree
say_en.note: Lists affected groups, then waits for your approval.

say_en.text: Which groups still have legacy memory files to migrate?
say_en.note: Inventories .seed.md, CLAUDE.md and other legacy paths.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch; migrate its memory
say_en.note: Runs the migration for the affected group.
